title: Courtyard House
method: Native SVG facade geometry: building volumes and roof, then openings and landscaping, then material details.
limitations: A fictional original house illustration; not a construction drawing, measured plan or real property listing.

notes: Roof, house volumes, arched openings, garden wall and vegetation match source geometry, order and warm palette. Source and final comparison panels are pixel-identical. The house is a fictional architectural illustration, not a measured plan or real property listing.

Inspected actual offline Chromium source/drawing/final preview plus opening/middle/final on light, dark and checkerboard backgrounds. Opening is blank without added blue decoration; exterior transparency and source-colored interior areas are preserved.
Inspected decoded GIF opening, drawing and final frames: 480x312, 41 stored frames, 4800 ms including final hold. The declared #F8F5EB GIF matte is opaque, while HTML and PNG retain exterior alpha.
Original outline colors are retained. Dark source outlines have lower contrast on dark test surfaces; the supplied light matte provides the intended presentation contrast.
